name: io.github.cgallic/realworldmcp
title: Real World MCP
description: Connects AI clients to independently operated real-world MCP providers through one platform.

tools.name: service_catalog
tools.description: Start with goal to plan the requested outcome in conversation. Use query and location for directory lookup. Returns sourced provider prices, intake routes and agent handoffs. Supply action_id for an executable service schema, or omit arguments to list native and connected actions.

goal.description: User’s desired outcome in their own words. Returns the provider, evidence and next MCP call.

query.description: Find a physical capability or provider by keyword, such as pollen, surfboard or satellite launch.

location.description: Location for additional Maps and portfolio search links. Curated matches are worldwide.

tools.name: connect_service
tools.description: Connect a provider account. Browser services return a private connection URL where the user logs in; the agent then operates that same session. Native public services need no login. Never put a provider password or key in this tool.

tools.name: execute_service
tools.description: Request an action by its catalog ID and inputs. Managed native actions return actual provider results. Agent mode returns the connected service/task for the caller agent to operate with control_service. An agent_action_required response is not task completion. Physical purchases require the user’s transaction authorization.

tools.name: control_service
tools.description: Operate the same service connection where the user logged in. Pass a browser/desktop/Python/artifact command; poll service_status for actual results. Only perform authorized provider actions.

tools.name: service_status
tools.description: Read one account-owned service connection or command. Queued/provisioned status is not a completed provider transaction.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search every tool behind Real World MCP by keyword and optional category: our live free tools, tools federated from remote MCP servers (roads, transit, oceans, power markets, PCB parts, fabrication), providers that need your own account, listed paid providers and self-hosted servers. Returns ids, status, whether each is callable now, and a spend_guard flag.

category.description: Optional, e.g. "Sky & space", "Earth", "Vehicles & maps", "Energy", "Make things", "Mail & print", "Calls"

status.description: Optional filter. live and federated are callable now.

tier.description: Optional filter by tier. referral tools return a referral object from call_tool.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Full details for one id from search_tools (e.g. "satnogs.observations" or "commutescout.check_route"): input schema, price, guard level, attribution and how to call it.

tools.name: call_tool
tools.description: Run any tool by id with its arguments (see get_tool for the schema). live and federated tools run. referral-tier tools return {status:"referral", access, endpoint, auth, price, deep_link, ...} so you can complete the task with the provider directly. Tools with a spend guard (orders, mail, calls, quotes sent to real businesses) return a dry run, with the referral, unless confirm_spend is true and max_spend_usd is within the tool's per-call cap.

arguments.description: The tool's input, matching its input schema

confirm_spend.description: Set true only after the user approved the cost or the outbound action. Default false: dry run.

max_spend_usd.description: Most this one call may cost, in US dollars. Required with confirm_spend for paid tools.

tools.name: search_workflows
tools.description: Find bounded multi-step job plans, including source-backed public-data briefings and a remote-telescope handoff plan. Discovery does not execute any step.

query.description: Optional job keywords, e.g. coastal, aurora or telescope

tools.name: get_workflow
tools.description: Retrieve one reviewed workflow plan, input schema, dependencies, success criteria and limitations. Plan retrieval never executes tools or provider actions.

tools.name: run_workflow
tools.description: Run only the registry-owned native public-data reads for a workflow, with bounded concurrency and a shared deadline. Return successful source results alongside failures. Provider, agent and local-processing steps return explicit unexecuted handoffs. No booking, purchases, device control or local filesystem access.

input.description: Inputs matching get_workflow.input_schema; never include credentials or secrets

tools.name: provision_runtime
tools.description: Provision a managed browser and Python workspace for a service without an API/MCP. The current runtime provides headless Chromium and Python. Returns an asynchronous provisioning job. Use runtime_status, then runtime_action to operate the website, process files and retrieve results. Requires a verified account access token or signed-in session. Does not include service accounts or permission to buy/book/contact people.

runtime_kind.description: Isolated browser or visible Linux desktop, with Python and file artifacts. The user and agent operate the same session.

tools.name: runtime_action
tools.description: Queue one ordered operation in your managed session: navigate/snapshot/click/fill/select/press, Python execution (20 seconds max), artifact list/read, or close. Poll the returned job with runtime_status. Python runs in /workspace inside the session container; save output files in artifacts/ for retrieval. No host shell or files are exposed. Only perform provider transactions/communications authorized by the user. Reuse idempotency_key for a retry of the same command; uncertain actions are never automatically replayed.

arguments.description: navigate: {url}; snapshot: {}; click: {selector}; fill/select: {selector,value}; press: {key}; python.run: {code,timeout_seconds?}; artifacts.read: {id}; artifacts.list/session.close: {}. Use node selectors returned by the last browser snapshot.

tools.name: runtime_status
tools.description: Read exactly one owned job (including its actual result/artifact manifest), or one owned session and command metadata. A queued/provisioning state is not completion. Screenshots/files carry content hashes and timestamps. Session workspaces expire after 15 minutes.

tools.name: satnogs__satellite
tools.description: Look up a satellite in SatNOGS DB by NORAD catalog number: names, status, launch date, countries, telemetry decoders and how many radio transmitters it has. Free, live. Provider: SatNOGS.

norad_id.description: NORAD catalog number, e.g. 25544 for the ISS

tools.name: satnogs__observations
tools.description: Find recent SatNOGS ground-station recordings of a satellite (or by one station): pass times, station, frequency, plus direct links to the waterfall PNG and audio OGG. Free, live. Provider: SatNOGS.

tools.name: global_meteor_network__latest_meteors
tools.description: The newest meteor trajectories filmed by the Global Meteor Network: time, shower, brightness, speed, mass and where each started and ended in the sky. Filter by shower code (e.g. ORI, STA) or brightness. Free, live. Provider: Global Meteor Network.

shower.description: IAU 3-letter shower code, e.g. ORI, STA, GEM

brighter_than_mag.description: Only meteors with peak absolute magnitude at or below this (lower is brighter), e.g. -2

tools.name: usgs_earthquakes__recent
tools.description: Earthquakes from the USGS worldwide catalog in the last 1-30 days, newest or biggest first, optionally within a radius of a place. Returns magnitude, place, time, depth, tsunami flag, PAGER alert and the USGS event page. Free, live. Provider: USGS Earthquake Hazards Program.

days.description: How many days back to search

lat.description: Optional: latitude to search around (give with lon)

lon.description: Optional: longitude to search around (give with lat)

radius_km.description: Search radius when lat/lon are given

tools.name: nws__forecast
tools.description: The National Weather Service forecast for a U.S. location: day and night periods with temperature, wind, chance of precipitation and a short summary. Free, live. Provider: NOAA National Weather Service.

tools.name: noaa_tides__tides_near
tools.description: Finds the nearest NOAA tide prediction station to a U.S. coastal location and returns the coming high and low tides (MLLW, metres, UTC) plus the latest measured water level when the station has a gauge. Free, live. Provider: NOAA Tides & Currents.

max_distance_km.description: Give up if the nearest station is farther than this

tools.name: adsb_lol__aircraft_near
tools.description: Live aircraft near a place, received over ADS-B radio by community receivers: callsign, registration, type, altitude, speed, heading and distance, nearest first. Free, live. Provider: adsb.lol.

tools.name: uniprot__search_proteins
tools.description: Search UniProtKB by name, gene, organism or accession (e.g. "insulin human", "BRCA1", "P69905") and get protein name, genes, organism, length and curated function. Free, live. Provider: UniProt.

query.description: Search text or a UniProt accession

tools.name: lichess__daily_puzzle
tools.description: Today's Lichess puzzle: the position (FEN), side to move, rating, themes, the solution in UCI moves and a link to play it. Free, live. Provider: Lichess.
